utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? I think it's Saturday morning—either 9 or 10, some place around here.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, next Saturday morning, that's the plan—bring broken stuff and we fix it together.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, sounds good. I might drop by if I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Faye! Just wanted to let you know the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh really? Sunday works better for me. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It starts at 9 AM, same time as before. Hope to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sam, do you happen to know when the repair drive is? I keep forgetting—I think I have a blender to bring, but I'm all mixed up on the day and time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It's this Saturday, from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center. Excited to see your blender!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Saturday! Thanks, Sam—I'll make sure to bring that blender. I think Tess mentioned something about 10 AM, so that lines up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah, are you coming to the repair drive next Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? Sorry, I think I missed something—what are you referring to?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, it's a neighborhood event where everyone brings broken items and we fix them together. Vik is bringing his toaster—should be fun!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: So, are you in for helping out at the community center this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'd love to, but I've been trying to catch up on the repair drive schedule. Have you heard anything?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's this Saturday morning, starting at 9. We'll be there all day, and every hand helps!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo! Have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the community center and could use a hand!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm on it. Bring broken stuff to the community center at 10.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks Leo! Can you help spread the word to some of the other neighbors too?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, sorry I'm late. What's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's just neighbors helping each other out with repairs.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good. I'll bring my old toaster then. Anything else I should know?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Nell! Are you planning to come to the repair drive this weekend? I heard it's starting at 10 AM on Saturday, but I'm waiting to hear back from Quinn to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I thought Opal said it starts at 9 AM, but you might want to double-check with her. I'm planning to go—still need to gather supplies though.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, 9 AM? I'll have to check with both Quinn and Opal to make sure. Thanks for letting me know!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you checked if the repair drive is compatible with our version?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good question! I can check the specs on my toolbox app if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, go ahead and check. I want to know for sure before we proceed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm still waiting for a firm start time. Vik said Saturday, but that's not enough for me to plan around.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So Vik mentioned Saturday? I thought the repair drive was next weekend—let me double-check the dates.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Vik said next Saturday, but no start time yet. I need that to plan my day.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Tools too? I hadn't thought of that. Let me check what we have and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Rey. Just let me know what you're missing—I've got a stash of spare parts and tools if needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo. I'll take inventory tonight and message you tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's a community repair drive this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center parking lot. Come help fix things!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure that will actually fix anything? I've seen those repair drives before and they just scratch the surface.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I understand your concern, but we've organized this one really well with a list of specific items to fix and volunteers with skills. It should make a real difference.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: So, could I bring my toolbox if I come?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, bring your toolbox! But I still don't know the exact start time for Saturday—hope we find out soon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Alright, I'll wait to hear about the time then.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Uh, I think the repair drive is Saturday, but I've heard both 9 and 10 AM. You'd better double-check.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Right, Saturday. I'll double-check the start time with Vik.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, sounds good.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure that repair drive is going to work? I've seen those things fail before.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? Sorry, I think I missed something—what are you referring to?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: The repair drive for our system—the one we were all discussing. You really haven't heard about it?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just realized we might be missing a socket wrench for those tight bolts. Did anyone check the toolkit thoroughly?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think I have an extra socket wrench in my garage. I'll go grab it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, thanks Opal! That's a relief. While you're at it, could you also check if we have a spare set of screws? I'd hate to find one missing mid-repair.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Sam, any update on when that repair drive is supposed to head out?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, it's this Saturday. We're fixing up the old playground equipment.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, this Saturday? Good to know. Need any help with the equipment?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I think it wraps up around 5 PM, so you've got plenty of time!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, and just a heads-up—the drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, thanks Rosa! I must've mixed up the days — Sunday it is, then. I'll make sure to update my list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Quinn, are we still on for the repair drive next weekend? I want to double-check the time and location.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, it's actually this Saturday, not next weekend! We're meeting at the community center at 9 AM. You're still in, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, this Saturday at 9 at the community center. I'll be there—anything else I should bring?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Gus, are you planning to come to the repair drive this Saturday? It starts at 9 AM at the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet, Nell! I'll be there with my toolbox ready to help fix things up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I'm so glad to hear that! Opal mentioned it's going to be a big help for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Eli, are you planning to come to the repair drive next Saturday? It's going to be a great community event.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'd like to, but do you know what time it starts? I need a definite time for my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It starts at 10 AM, Eli. Hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Leo, I'm so glad you asked! I think it's at 10 AM, but I need to check with Quinn to be sure. I'll let you know!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, just let me know if it changes. I'll bring my old toaster.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I just checked with Quinn, and it's definitely 10 AM on Saturday. See you there with your toaster!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, Opal! It's this Saturday. I think it starts at 9 AM, but let me double-check the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: 9 AM, you say? I thought Tess mentioned 10, but I'm always mixing things up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Let me look at the flyer again—I'll confirm the time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We're collecting tools and supplies to fix up the community center this weekend. Can you join us?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we have a socket wrench for those tight bolts? Pia mentioned that might be missing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hmm, a socket wrench? Not on my list yet. I'll check my toolbox and ask around—we'll make sure we have one.
